decisions.reason: A core safety shoe line in a large, slack-rich footwear maker shows no performance shortfall that would trigger problemistic search after only two years.
The comfort insole is a cheap complement to shoe sales, but its low visibility and overlap with the other insoles keep a modest risk that the range gets consolidated.
The supportive insole fits the tailored foot-measurement offer, though its overlap with the flagship moulded insole makes it the likeliest candidate for pruning.
The ergonomic series has its own page and matches the firm's innovation direction, so management keeps carrying it while its results build up.
Firefighter and rescue boots serve a certification-driven niche with long buying cycles, and slack lets the firm judge them over a longer horizon.
The home-page flagship moulded insole carries strong strategic commitment and would not be held against aspirations this early.
